limitations.detail: HiGHS 1.12.0 includes cupdlp_cs.c whose source says it references Tim Davis SuiteSparse CSparse; real libhighs exports cupdlp_dcs_* symbols. Exact CSparse origin/version and its corresponding notice have not been established. A parent MIT license is not treated as proof of that embedded code license.

Real libhighs includes IPX and BASICLU. HiGHS source omits the license.txt referenced by IPX headers. Current official upstream candidates differ from the vendored files (IPX 0/69 exact; BASICLU 17/49 exact); their license texts are not substituted for an unverified historical revision.

sourceAccessStatement: The identified third-party source is available under its own accompanying licenses at each immutable source URL and SHA256 listed below; OR-Tools patches are included locally and identify the modifications.
